prompt: Add a server-driven operations table and one required chart to an existing console.
expected_actions: scan routes, query ownership, current rendered UI, design system, package manager, and existing tests
classify the bounded extension as preserve UI impact and record existing product and flow constraints
use TanStack Table v9 by default when compatible
compare the two preferred chart families and select only one after approval if new
model loading, empty, error, permission, keyboard, focus, and responsive behavior
record Playwright project, retry, trace, and accessibility evidence
forbidden_actions: migrate an existing lockfile during unrelated work
duplicate server state into a global store
claim browser compatibility from one unrecorded run
change information architecture or interaction flows as incidental table or chart cleanup
